messages:
laura (Product Ops): Quick catch-all thread for questions that came up during the AH. I'll capture owners/links here so we can close the loop. @here :wave:

carlos (Eng): Roadmap clarification: will Optimize autopilot (batching + quant suggestions) be in GA with Dedicated or a later release? julia (CEO): Optimize autopilot will be beta at Dedicated GA and generally available ~4 weeks after GA depending on canary results.

amir (Research): For the eval/regression question 1: we will publish the perf and quality evaluation harness used for the canary. owners: research + eng-ml. expected: draft next Tue.

zoe (DevEx): Customers asked about SDK changes for streaming + function-calls during Dedicated rollout. Carlos: SDK v2 will be backwards-compatible; we'll publish migration notes and sample snippets. Milestone: SDK PR + changelog by Thu.

laura (Product Ops): Action list from Q&A (short): 1) Publish Optimize beta feature brief (owner: product) 1 due Mon. 2) Share eval harness + summary (owner: amir) 1 due Tue. 3) SDK migration notes and examples (owner: carlos/DevEx) 1 due Thu. 4) Office hours sign-up for customers (owner: support) 1 1st office hour next Wed.

carlos (Eng): Small note on telemetry: we need the canary to export per-tenant cost-traces (token cost + batching efficiency). nina in infra will help. I'll link the telemetry schema once PR is up: https://redwood.internal/prs/telemetry/canary-export (internal).

amir (Research): Eval items to include: prompt set baseline, hallucination rate per model, generation latency per token, QA regression delta. We'll also seed three customer prompts (anonymized).

ops-bot: Slides and recording: https://redwood.internal/ah/2026-03-22-slides-ops and https://redwood.internal/ah/2026-03-22-recording (indexed).

laura (Product Ops): Partnerships question: marketplace listing assets needed (short FAQ, one-pager, pricing blurb). Partnerships + marketing to own; draft needed by Fri.

zoe (DevEx): I'll run a small internal demo next Tues for the sales engineers so they have sample code and can repro streaming/function-call examples. pinging @carlos for SDK sample snippets. :rocket:

julia (CEO): Great coordination. Please flag any blockers for legal/compliance early (esp for private deployments). We'll escalate if needed.

laura (Product Ops): Please drop a one-line comment in this thread when your deliverable is live. I'll collate and send a summary to execs on Friday. Thanks everyone! :slightly_smiling_face:
